pre_eye.nudge: Focus on shelter, a work bench, and better ore gear before chasing bosses.
pre_eye.hint: Build a valid house for the Guide (light, chair, table or work bench, door, 60+ tiles). Mine iron or gold, craft an anvil, then make better weapons and armor.
pre_eye.answer: Typical order: surface base → iron/gold gear → Suspicious Looking Eye (6 lenses at demon altar) → Eye of Cthulhu at night. Explore corruption/crimson for shadow orbs/hearts afterward.

post_eye.nudge: Underground corruption or crimson holds the next progression trigger.
post_eye.hint: Smash shadow orbs or crimson hearts with a hammer to get a meteor and eventually summon the Eater or Brain. Upgrade to gold/platinum gear first.
post_eye.answer: After Eye: loot corruption/crimson for orbs/hearts, prepare platforms and piercing weapons, then break the third orb/heart to spawn Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu.

post_eater_brain.nudge: The dungeon awaits — but only after you've handled the world's evil.
post_eater_brain.hint: Defeat the Eater/Brain, then talk to the Old Man at the dungeon entrance at night after you're ready for Skeletron.
post_eater_brain.answer: Craft better gear from demonite/crimtane, explore the dungeon after defeating Skeletron (not before — the Old Man will kill you).

pre_wall.nudge: Hellstone and a long bridge change the game.
pre_wall.hint: Build a hell bridge, mine hellstone (watch for lava), craft a guide voodoo doll, and plan your Underworld fight for the Wall of Flesh.
pre_wall.answer: Pre-hardmode finale: gear up in the dungeon, build a hell bridge, collect hellstone bars, then throw the Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in the Underworld to summon the Wall of Flesh.

post_wall.nudge: The world just got harder — prioritize containment and new ore.
post_wall.hint: Hardmode spreads corruption/crimson and hallow. Use the Clentaminator later; immediately look for cobalt/palladium in the world.
post_wall.answer: Break demon/crimson altars with a hammer to spawn hardmode ores. Build a quarantine around your base and upgrade to cobalt/palladium → mythril/orichalcum → adamantite/titanium.
